factual_claims.claim: LLMs struggle to provide actionable guidance in real-world physical environments because they lack situational awareness.
Traditional LLMs often fail to recognize their incomplete understanding of the physical world and rarely seek clarifications.
SituationalLLM reduces hallucinations by proactively identifying missing environmental details and requesting clarifications.
The SAD-Instruct dataset contains 95.2 million tokens.
The SituationalLLM model was fine-tuned for 10 epochs on 76.9M tokens.
SituationalLLM outperforms state-of-the-art LLMs (GPT-4, LLaMA-3) in providing precise, task-specific, and contextually relevant instructions.
The 3DSSG dataset provides 3D semantic scene graphs for 1,482 RGB-D scans.
The model's performance remains reliant on the accuracy and completeness of the input scene graph representations.
SituationalLLM demonstrates robust adherence to ethical guidelines by avoiding harmful, biased, or unsafe instructions.
